definitions.explanation: Performing tasks quickly and smoothly with good technique. Describes someone who handles work or tasks with admirable skill.

examples.japanese: {手際|てぎわ}よく{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}った。
{彼|かれ}の{手際|てぎわ}よい{仕事|しごと}ぶりに{感心|かんしん}した。
examples.english: I was impressed by how efficiently he worked.

examples.japanese: {新人|しんじん}なのに{手際|てぎわ}よく{対応|たいおう}できるのは{素晴|すば}らしい。
examples.english: It's impressive that she can handle things so deftly even though she's new.

notes:
USAGE:
{手際|てぎわ}よい is often used in the adverbial form {手際|てぎわ}よく. The noun {手際|てぎわ} alone means "skill" or "performance." The negative form {手際|てぎわ}が{悪|わる}い means clumsy or inefficient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手際|てぎわ}よく{片付|かたづ}ける (to tidy up efficiently)
- {手際|てぎわ}よく{進|すす}める (to proceed smoothly)
- {手際|てぎわ}のいい{人|ひと} (a deft person)

FORMS:
{手際|てぎわ}のいい and {手際|てぎわ}がいい are also commonly used with the same meaning.

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {手際|てぎわ}よくなかったら
